title: Advances in N-heterocyclic carbene organocatalysis from 2015 to 2024
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00600G, Review Article
Dan Ling, Yusong Ran, Fachang Yang, Xiaoqun Yang, Xingxing Wu, Shi-Chao Ren, Zhichao Jin
The key progress in the field of N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC) organocatalysis during the period of 2015 to 2024 is systematically summarized and discussed in this review.
